Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: CrowdFix
Description:
Cuts per-frame engine overhead that causes stutter and low FPS, most noticeable in crowded areas.
Skips idle GPU resource notifiers, chains job worker wake-ups, drops repeated skeleton pose syncs, trims the culling visibility clear and shortens the graphics allocator lock.
Each fix can be toggled via /crowdfix
Punchline: Smoother frame times by cutting engine overhead.
